mainly serves the Metropolis Sub-District in Downtown, and is currently 6.91 km long.

Fun Facts

  • Due to the circular nature of this line, unlike most other lines, this line only has a single track.

  • October 15 2020: After 4 years, this line formed a complete ring.

  • September 13 2022: Origin NR Station Stop begun operations.
